articles.summary: This past October, Burford Managing Director Andrew Cohen participated in a panel discussion hosted by NYU School of Law’s Center on Civil Justice. The discussion focused on disclosure of legal finance and included discussions about several key misperceptions about the commercial legal finance industry as a whole.
articles.title: Legal finance misperceptions addressed at NYU Center on Civil Justice panel

articles.summary: Burford Vice Chair David Perla speaks to The Insurer about how opportunities for litigation finance and insurance to work "hand in hand" are increasing, despite the narrative that the two industries are at odds with each other. Learn more.
articles.title: David Perla speaks with The Insurer about the symbiosis between legal finance and insurance

articles.summary: Burford has been ranked Tier 1 in the US and Tier 2 in the UK by the Legal 500's funder rankings. The report notes that Burford "excels in the financing of high-value, complex disputes, including antitrust and competition claims, and bankruptcy and insolvency matters." Learn more.
articles.title: Legal 500 ranks Burford Tier 1 in US and Tier 2 in UK

articles.summary: Burford recently hosted an interactive roundtable for senior competition litigators and economists. We highlight some of the key takeaways from the discussion around tackling complex cases, particularly in relation to obtaining a CPO. Learn more.
articles.title: Competition litigation insights: Legal and economic perspectives on certification and beyond

articles.summary: The Energy Republic Magazine features key takeaways from Burford's recent Energy Transition Disputes Report in their December 2024 edition. Learn more.
articles.title: The Energy Republic Magazine features Burford's research on energy transition disputes

articles.summary: Lexology (formerly Who's Who Legal/WWL) has recognized Burford Director Jörn Eschment as part of its 2025 Client Choice Awards. Learn more.
articles.title: Director Jörn Eschment wins Lexology's Client Choice Award for legal finance in Germany

articles.summary: The Financial Analyst covers Christopher Bogart's interview with CityAM, where he highlighted that the desirability of investing in UK-based legal funding ventures could be reduced due to the uncertainty surrounding the PACCAR case and the postponement of the Litigation Funding Bill. Learn more.
articles.title: The Financial Analyst reports on Burford's deliberate shift away from London dispute resolution activities, highlighting problems within the UK’s legal and regulatory framework

articles.summary: Burford's Charles Griffin and Greg McPolin author an Insights piece for Bloomberg Law entitled "Legal Finance Is an Emergent Tool as Health-Care Industry Shifts." Learn more.
articles.title: Charles Griffin and Greg McPolin write for Bloomberg Law about the role of legal finance in healthcare disputes

articles.summary: Law.com International speaks to Burford's Co-Head of EMEA Daniel Hall on opportunities for using legal finance in the UAE, with a particular focus on construction disputes. Learn more.
articles.title: Daniel Hall speaks to Law.com International about Burford's UAE business

articles.summary: Burford CEO Christopher Bogart is quoted in The Times on how "[L]egal services in England are harmed by inaction on litigation funding." Bogart says, "'We’ve already moved some of our dispute resolution work out of London to other markets like Paris, Singapore and New York,'" and adds that Burford is 'not alone in moving work to other jurisdictions.'" He continues: "'the government has ‘an acute issue it needs to fix — and urgently — otherwise it’s going to continue costing the legal sector valuable business.'" Learn more.
articles.title: Christopher Bogart speaks with The Times about how "[L]egal services in England are harmed by inaction on litigation funding"

articles.summary: Burford Vice Chair David Perla and Co-Head of EMEA and Co-Head of Asset Recovery Michael Redman are featured in a Legal Business article discussing the latest trends in legal finance. Learn more.
articles.title: David Perla and Michael Redman featured in Legal Business article about 2024 legal finance trends

articles.summary: Burford CEO Christopher Bogart speaks with CityAM about how, while London has a "'very strong global reputation for legal services,'" government delays related to the PACCAR case have resulted in "'uncertainty'" and thus, Burford is "'less focused on using dispute resolution in London than we would have been a couple of years ago.'" Learn more.
articles.title: Burford's CEO talks to CityAM about the company's decision to reduce dispute resolution activities in London, citing "'uncertainties'" caused by government delays

articles.summary: Learn more about the latest GAO report which highlights the critical role of legal finance in patent litigation.
articles.title: GAO report reflects positively on patent litigation finance
